about: The example configs check.sh runs. `built` names a wasm that check.sh builds from reference/; `mainnet_account` names a public mainnet account whose code check.sh downloads with a read-only view_code query and compares with `sha256` (third-party code is not stored in the kit). The mainnet examples exercise the plain NEP-141 behaviour of the code only.

examples.name: reference
examples.shows: the shortest config: an init that gives the supply to owner.near

examples.name: reference-distribution
examples.shows: extra accounts, setup calls after init (registration and distribution), a watched account that is not an actor, a named funder

examples.name: factory-minted
examples.shows: an init only the factory may call, storage registration and minting after init

examples.name: launchpad-token
examples.shows: an init sent by a platform account, a token account under the platform's name, a stub for the exchange the init calls
